t: Foundation should evolve after prolonged interaction — sustained attention reveals identity drift
description: _project_foundation is set once at init and rarely revisited. But after 100+ sessions, the project may have evolved past its original identity, boundaries, and success criteria. Foundation should update itself when sustained interaction reveals significant drift. The trigger: if the user has spent N hours over M sessions and the work pattern no longer matches the foundation's stated scope, surface a foundation review prompt. This is the foundation PEVing itself — perceive drift, execute review, verify updated identity.
implications: Foundation gate (wai-foundation-gate.md) currently only fires when foundation is incomplete — extend to fire when stale
Define staleness: >30 sessions since last foundation review, OR >50% of recent work outside stated scope
Stewardship guard already detects drift — connect it to foundation review trigger
Foundation evolution_log should track when and why identity changed
This closes the loop: attention → drift detection → foundation review → updated identity
